# OptimaCoreTech

> OptimaCoreTech is a web design, app development and AI agent studio based in Antwerp, Belgium. It builds fast, SEO-ready websites, iOS and Android apps, and AI agents that answer customers, take bookings and capture leads 24/7 for businesses across Belgium. More than 50 businesses have worked with OptimaCoreTech. Every project is quoted individually after a free call.

OptimaCoreTech (also written Optima CoreTech, Optima Core Tech, OptimaCore Tech) is based in Antwerp (2060), Belgium, and works with businesses across Belgium. Contact: +32 465 856 075, optimacoretech@outlook.com, Monday to Friday 8:30-18:30. Every project is quoted individually after a free call; there are no fixed packages.

## Services
- [Web design and development](https://www.optimacoretech.com/web-design-antwerp.html): Custom, mobile-first websites, online shops, booking sites and redesigns that load fast and are built to rank on Google.
- [Mobile app development](https://www.optimacoretech.com/app-development.html): iOS and Android apps for bookings, loyalty, ordering and internal tools, plus the web dashboards behind them.
- [AI agents and AI receptionists](https://www.optimacoretech.com/ai-agents.html): AI agents for websites, WhatsApp and phone that answer questions, take bookings and orders and pass leads to the team, 24/7.
- [Process automation](https://www.optimacoretech.com/service.html): Connecting business tools, syncing data and automating repetitive work.
- [Cloud solutions](https://www.optimacoretech.com/service.html): Managing and synchronising data across platforms securely.
- [IT consulting and cybersecurity](https://www.optimacoretech.com/service.html): Advice on IT setup and protection against online threats.
- [Search engine optimisation](https://www.optimacoretech.com/web-design-antwerp.html): Technical SEO, structured data and Google Search Console setup on every site.
